# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Reviewed the approved habitat-registry review output, confirmed there were no follow-up amendments to apply, made no code changes, and reran the targeted habitat/save-load and scenario materialization/startup-override suites to verify the current implementation remains green.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the latest review output and current workspace state to determine whether any actionable follow-up fixes remained for the habitat-registry task.
2. [Completed] Confirmed the review was approved with no follow-up amendments, so I left the implementation unchanged rather than introducing unnecessary churn.
3. [Completed] Reran the targeted core and scenario regression suites covering habitat registry freshness, save/load behavior, and scenario materialization/startup overrides.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test habitat_registry --test save_load` passed (32 habitat tests, 27 save/load tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios --test materialization --test startup_overrides` passed (9 materialization tests, 4 startup-override tests).

## Outstanding Risks

- This stage reran only the targeted habitat-registry and scenario suites; the full workspace test matrix was not rerun.
- The worktree still contains an unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory, which was intentionally left untouched.
